label: Toma di Mendatica
aka: Toma di Mendatica dell'Alta Valle Arroscia

about.text: A semi-hard, pressed toma from the upper Arroscia valley around Mendatica, in the province of Imperia, Liguria. Milk warmed to about 37 °C is given calf rennet, the curd is broken by hand, pressed and turned to expel whey, then salted dry or in brine. It is aged for about 40 days.

sources.text: The method, appearance, area and PAT status; Liguria, from the list of Italian cheeses.
